subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: 3D objects, position and 2D shapes
source.subtopic: 2D shapes: recognise and name circles, triangles and squares

show.line: A circle is round. A triangle has three sides. A square has four sides the same. Shapes!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say its name.
Count the sides of the square. How many?

rounds.praise: A circle is round. No corners!

rounds.prompt: Which thing is shaped like a triangle?
Sort the shapes. Circle, triangle or square?

hints: Count the sides. Three is a triangle, four is a square.
Round with no corners is a circle.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this shape.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Three sides. It is a square!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Three sides makes a triangle. A square has four.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the sides. One, two, three. A triangle!

parent_line: Can name circles, triangles and squares and count their sides.
